'''Garwooken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], Garwooken was present in [[Vanster Enan's Cantina (Tolea Biqua franchise)|Vanster Enan's Cantina]].

==Behind the scenes==
The miniature representing the character of Garwooken was based on a Wookiee concept sketch by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="Impact">{{SW|url=news/the-big-impact-of-west-end-games-star-wars-miniatures|text=The Big Impact of West End Games' ''Star Wars'' Miniatures|nolive=1}}</ref>
